title: list_workspaces input
description: The named workspaces and their member repositories: the names get_ecosystem takes. Needs no repository_id; answers from the catalog.

envelope.description: compact leaves out the snapshot-wide parts of the envelope (unresolved reasons, standing limitations) that an earlier answer from the same snapshot already gave; query-specific limits stay.
